description: [Companies] Favorite a list of companies in one call: up to 100 in total across companyIds, names and requestNames. names takes company names or website/careers URLs and Trackly matches each one. The result lists favorited (newly favorited), alreadyFavorite, needsChoice (a name that matched a differently named company, such as "Square" matching Block, a likely misspelling, or several companies; nothing was written for it), requested (a company Trackly does not monitor yet, now requested), favoriteWhenAdded (requested companies that will be favorited automatically once Trackly adds them) and failed (with a code such as company_not_found, company_inactive, rate_limited with retryAfterSeconds, unidentified_url for a job link that names no employer, or invalid_request). For each needsChoice item, ask the user, then call again with the chosen company in companyIds, or with the original name in requestNames to request it separately. Safe to repeat: already favorited companies and pending requests are reused. Company requests share the account limit of 20 per rolling 60 seconds.

companyIds.description: Trackly company IDs to favorite, e.g. from trackly_search_companies.

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.

names.description: Company names or website/careers URLs to match and favorite, e.g. ["Stripe", "https://ramp.com"].

requestNames.description: Company names to request without matching, favorited automatically once Trackly adds them. Use for a needsChoice item the user wants requested separately.

name: trackly_favorite_companies
title: Companies · Favorite a list
